methods_quotes.q: Full vaccination was defined as receipt of ≥2 doses of JYNNEOS vaccine ≥24 days apart,
Partial vaccination was defined as receipt of ≥1 dose of JYNNEOS vaccine ≥2 weeks before illness onset but fully vaccinated criteria was not met.
Unvaccinated was defined as no evidence of vaccination before illness onset, or illness onset <2 weeks after receipt of the first vaccine dose.
